pageSize.description: Required. How many items fit on a page, which together with totalCount gives the number of pages. Must be at least 1; a smaller value throws.

sdsStyle.description: Whether the page and chevron targets are circles or rounded squares.

siblingCount.description: How many page numbers to keep on each side of the current page before the rest collapse into an ellipsis.

totalCount.description: Required. Total number of items being paged through: the whole set, not the current page.

truncateDropdown.description: When true the ellipsis is a menu of the pages it stands for. When false it is a disabled placeholder, and those pages can only be reached by stepping through with the chevrons.

onPageChange.description: A callback function triggered when the page number is changed.

onNextPage.description: A callback function triggered when the "Next" page button is clicked.

onPreviousPage.description: A callback function triggered when the "Previous" page button is clicked.

currentPage.description: Required. The page to mark as current, counted from 1. Pagination keeps no page state of its own.
